'## transforms' section heading
restates the survey question about what transformations were applied
answer label 'A:'

spans.assertion: extracted the year of birth from the birthday variable and created a new variable computed as 2013 minus year of birth
assumed that the month and day of birth have a negligible effect
divided redCards, yellowCards and yellowReds by the games variable, treating the results as average counts per referee-player pair and per game
averaged rater1 and rater2 into a single new variable, (rater1+rater2)/2, called the average rate
